development: Original seven failed buys and all previous40 validation stocks; previous studies retained and no longer treated as unseen
hypotheses: Payoff requirements are not forecasts. Estimated targets need support in at least two non-overlapping completed historical ranges; a lone extreme is insufficient corroboration.
The historical median is reference evidence, never an automatic ceiling.
Review lower-ranked feasible routes after higher-ranked vetoes; cap approved and pending payloads after review.
Keep first-day distinct LIVE entry confirmation and every original economic threshold unchanged.

candidate_method.forward_windows: non-overlapping completed windows, all ending before decision
candidate_method.scope: historical range envelope, not a calibrated win probability

validation.universe_rule: 20 equally spaced codes among remaining liquid ordinary shares, excluding all seed/scout and previous40 validation stocks
validation.numeric_protocol: Every eligible next-session open, only previous completed daily data; entry-day high/low not used as signal
validation.execution_scope: Historical ordinary-market price-path proxy; no invented odd-lot quotes, fills or full-market recall

acceptance: Keep modeled-target opportunities and real positive cases visible; all-WAIT is not a pass.
Report both wrong buys and missed reference opportunities using a fixed baseline denominator.
Keep uncertain entry, ambiguous daily barrier order and missing data explicit.
